notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.8 released 20 Aug 2025
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added options under Settings so the player can choose whether gains and losses summaries should be displayed after undertakings and phase endings.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added more hints to the hint system.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved instructions and feedback during lockpick mini-game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Shelter tools window will now close when switching tabs while it is open (It could get in the way when switching to daily planning, leaving a new player confused as to how to leave the shelter).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can now close notification messages with the ESC key. You can still close them by clicking on the trash can.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.7 released 19 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]It will now be indicated properly on the weapon selector bar when a broken weapon is equipped.
[*]Added more hints to the hint system.
[*]Fixed a bug where an npc crook running away would unintentionally attract rats or bats meant for another npc.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.6 released 15 Jul 2025
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a hint system which displays gameplay hints during loading transitions. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added difficulty settings. A player can now choose between an Easy, Normal and Hard game when starting a new game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.5 released 13 Jul 2025
notes.content: [list][*][p]Ultrawide screen support added. Players with ultrawide resolution screens can now play the game without having to force HD resolution via launch options.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tweaked courage and morale gain for killing enemies. The hero will now gain courage faster when killing enemies and also gain a bit of morale for every kill.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increased the condition gained for a tool when someone with sharpening skill sharpens a tool.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
